Use a passkey on your security key

Passkeys on a security key

This app lets websites and apps use the passkeys on a FIDO2 security key, tapped on the back of the phone or plugged in.\n\nTo use it, choose it as a passkey provider under Passwords, passkeys & accounts. When a site asks for a passkey, pick “Security key”.
